- Build a complete, playable browser-based 3D open-world action-adventure game starring a necromancer.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save verification screenshots as small JPEGs at viewport widths no greater than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

- The game is titled “Gravebound — The Ashen Wilds,” built with Three.js.

- Implemented procedural world and characters, movement, aiming, combat, abilities, objectives, enemies, UI, minimap, mobile controls, and game loop in `game.js`.

### Active
- Continue functional playtesting, especially interact with Soul Obelisks and verify quest progression/Wraith King encounter.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test reaching and awakening an obelisk with `F`, confirming quest progress and enemy spawning.
2. Check browser console and capture/inspect a latest JPEG screenshot after gameplay testing.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world, player, enemies, controls, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game canvas, HUD, controls, and modals.
- `style.css`: Visual styling, responsive rules, and overlay visibility.

## Important Context

- Latest console check reported no errors; earlier favicon 404 and WebGL ReadPixels warnings were not repeated in the latest check.
